verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is an OAuth scope description saying an app can delete Drive files. That implies first-party file deletion through the Drive API, but it is a single thin mention, and nothing documents retention controls. Community mentions of rclone backups are user-side workarounds and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented retention policies or settings, trash/permanent-deletion behavior, account-level data deletion controls, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: See, edit, create, and delete only the specific Google Drive files you use with this app
